name: Bank of Jiujiang Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Jiujiang Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services for individual customers, corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Financial Market Business segments. The company offers corporate and personal loans, trade financing, depositing sproducts, granting short-term, medium-term and long-term loans, and other types of corporate and personal intermediary services; and card and personal wealth management services. It also conducts money market or repurchase transactions, and financial investments. In addition, the company provides domestic and overseas settlement…
